Maya: Quick sync  Cascade (partner) wants a joint marketplace listing + integration webinar. Need blog headline, benchmark callout, webinar date, co-branded assets, and lead routing. Who can take what?

Ben: I can run webinar ops (reg page, recording). Propose Tue Feb 14 11am PT.

Riley: Good for me. For leads, suggest SFDC campaign 'CASCADE-MKT-2027' and an initial 48h triage to partner-sdr. Add intent >=75 promo to AE.

Sofia: Ill draft the blog + three headline options. Suggest CTAs: "Install connector" + "Request demo" with UTM utm_source=marketplace&utm_campaign=cascade_launch&utm_medium=partner

Liam: Eng-ML here  will run a short benchmark: p50/p95, tokens/sec at 128/1024, and cost delta for int8 vs fp16. Need sample prompts and expected peak qps.

Arjun: Partner wants a co-branded slide pack and a short customer quote. Also wants rights to republish the webinar recording.

PartnerBot: Cascade assets uploaded to #partner-assets. Speaker Arjun confirmed. (automated)

Maya: Plan: 25m integration demo (Arjun + Maya), 15m benchmark (Liam), 20m live Q&A. Keep total <=60m.

Ben: Action items: Ben = webinar ops, Liam = benchmark numbers, Sofia = blog draft, Riley = SFDC routing doc, Maya = partner comms. Target: assets ready by Feb 4 for review.

Sofia: I'll drop the blog outline in Drive and share link. Also will avoid absolute claims until Liam confirms numbers.

Liam: Please send sample prompt lengths and a small traffic histogram (p10/p50/p90).

Riley: Draft routing doc uploaded: https://drive.redwood/cascade-routing. It includes SLA windows and nurture cadence.

Maya: Thanks team  I'll compile a one-pager and send to partner and our comms by tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
